overall: The AG found the Committee violated the Open Meeting Law by entering executive session under an improper Purpose 7 citation and by withholding the resulting minutes, and ordered compliance and release of the minutes.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Committee failed to provide executive session minutes after a request; the Committee's Purpose 7 executive session was challenged as improperly invoked.
allegations.key_passage: The Committee's invocation of the statutory right to privacy to convene this executive session was in error.

allegations.summary: Requester sought the October 9, 2014 executive session minutes, which the Committee withheld as privileged or exempt under the Public Records Law and attorney-client privilege.
allegations.key_passage: Additionally, because the October 9, 2014 executive session was not held in compliance with the Open Meeting Law, the Committee may not rely upon that law as the basis for continuing to withhold these minutes.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.
Release the October 9, 2014 executive session minutes in their entirety to the subject of the discussion within 30 days of receipt of the determination.
remedy_passage: We order the Committee's immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, and caution the Committee that a similar future violation may be considered evidence of an intentional violation of the Law.
